title: Elaborate Slate

sources.title: Elaborate Slate
markers: {{story|Elaborate Slate}} is a [[Story Item]] related to the [[Find the Githyanki Crèche]] quest.

summary: Lae’zel can use this quest slate to locate the Githyanki crèche.

fields.Acquisition: Carried by Sarth Baretha in the Mountain Pass.
fields.Use: Lae’zel can use the slate during Find the Githyanki Crèche. It is renamed Githyanki Map on use.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
